title: FLA import: implement shape tween / morph data extraction
description: flash8-binary.ts warns 'shape tween (morph) data is not imported'. Implement parsing of DefineMorphShape data from the FLA CPicFrame / shape tween records. The model has TweenType='shape' on frames and the SWF encoder emits DefineMorphShape2 (tag 84). Wire the FLA-side morph start/end shape extraction into the frame model so shape tweens round-trip through import → publish. Cross-reference ruffle/JPEXS for the binary layout.
